name: Teach one process at a time

pages.text: Before automating a recipe, run it manually and confirm the actual output. Then add transport, filters and collection.$(br2)Start with a small request. Check that ingredients reach the correct machine, fluids are available, reusable tools stay where needed and products return to storage.
Once the whole process works, increase batch sizes. Expanding a proven process is easier than investigating several new failures at once.
